title: Jaɓɓungal Ɓiɓɓe Leydi
intro: Aɗa jogori hawrude e ruuhu jarriborɗo seertude ɓurɗo luggiɗde, mo gite mum nganndi ɗemngal gonɗi kono ɓernde mum meeɗaa waasde yaakaare. E nder daartol fenaande, yiɗde, e jokkondire cakkitiiɗe, oo maccuɗo Alla tedduɗo wonti maande muñal haa abada. Hol muñɗo duuɓi mette cuuɗiiɗe, tan yiyde e weltaare ngartiraa e nder dumunna gooto ?
clues: Miin ko mi annabi mo innde mum wonti maande muñal e yeeso majjere mawnde.
Mi barkiniraama e ɓiɓɓe worɓe heewɓe, kono gooto ko kañum en woɗɓe itti mi.
Giɗli am e oon majjuɗo ina luggiɗi haa gite am mbeltii e sunaare, tee mi meeɗaa wullitaade so wonaa Alla.
Mi neli ɓiɓɓe am ɓee ngam yiylaade mo nji’mi oo e miñi mum, miɗo ñaagii ɓe nde ɓe ngoppataa yaakaare.
Nde gardiiɗo kabaaru oo ari, limre ndee fawi e yeeso am, ɗoon e ɗoon aduna oo laaɓi kadi.
Miɗo anndiraa Isra’iila, e nder ɓiɓɓe am sappo e ɗiɗo, leƴƴi sappo e ɗiɗi leñol mawngol ummii.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
